title: Payment caller (payment_terms_acceptance) has no regression pin on stored ip_text/user_agent
detail: Payment handler uses the helper (no bypass), but no unit or integration test asserts payment_terms_acceptance.ip_text/user_agent values — grep for user_agent|ip_text|SELECT length in payment_integration_test.gleam returns zero matches; tests there only count rows. A caller-side revert would go uncaught.
recommended_fix: Add a payment integration test posting accept-terms with an emoji-heavy user-agent/XFF and assert length(user_agent)<=512 / length(ip_text)<=64 on the stored row.

title: XFF no-comma branch (string.split_once Error path) lacks multi-codepoint pin
detail: The Error branch (no comma in x-forwarded-for) is exercised only by pre-existing ASCII test apply_submission_overlong_headers_truncated_test (x-forwarded-for: string.repeat("9", 500)), which cannot distinguish codepoint from grapheme slicing. Reverting just this branch to string.slice would fail no test.
recommended_fix: Add a unit test posting an emoji-only x-forwarded-for (no comma) and assert client_ip returns exactly 64 codepoints, pinning the Error branch's codepoint semantics.

title: Advisory test gate: PASS
evidence: make test-server: "1484 passed, no failures, 501 skipped"; make test-integration: "501 passed, no failures"; request_helpers_test.gleam asserts codepoint_length(sliced) == 512 / 64, ASCII == string.repeat("U", 512) / string.repeat("9", 64), absent -> "", short passthrough; gdpr_integration_test.gleam:2788 apply_submission_multi_codepoint_headers_bounded_test asserts resp.status |> should.equal(200) (line 2814) + ip_len 64 (2824) + ua_len 512 (2832); consent_integration_test.gleam:329 multi_codepoint_headers_within_check_bounds_test asserts status 204 (340) + ua_len 512 (349) + ip_len 64 (358)
detail: All 8 unit + 2 integration behaviours traced FULL: multi-codepoint UA->512, XFF->64, ASCII byte-identical, absent->'', short passthrough, first-entry-only, both live DB CHECK sites. Negative control verified real for all 4 new tests under string.slice revert (incl. /apply 500 path). Only 2 P3 gaps (payment caller, no-comma branch) — no P0/P1. P0 100%, P1 100%, overall ~95%.
recommended_fix: Raise to full coverage by adding the two P3 pins above; gate stays PASS as-is since neither gap is on a constraint-bound contract.
